(* FB_BenchRun — one benchmark loop body: baseline or variant, nIter iterations.
One call = one measured half of a pair. The base and the variant live in the same block and at the same nesting level, so that the dispatch overhead is the same and only the loop body differs.
Baseline: read - GVL_Bench.dwSink := dwSink + 1 (the same shape as the read variants); write - GVL_Bench.dwSinkW := UDINT_TO_DWORD(k AND 1), that is, writing a computed value into a separate DWORD sink without touching bits. The timer is SysTimeGetNs on the PLC (as before, one measurement = one loop pass).
nIter is chosen by the calibration in PRG_BitBench: half of a pair is about 0.2 ms, the whole round (one test) is no more than 80 ms of the t#200 ms cycle. *)
FUNCTION_BLOCK FB_BenchRun VAR_INPUT nWhich : INT; // 0 = baseline, 1 = variant nMode : INT; // 0 = read, 1 = write nVariant : INT; // 0..10 nIter : UDINT; // iterations in the loop END_VAR VAR_OUTPUT tDur : ULINT; // duration of the loop, ns dwRes : DWORD; // return code of SysTimeGetNs (0 = success) END_VAR VAR k : UDINT; t0 : ULINT; t1 : ULINT; END_VAR
